question: How many films are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film

question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer

question: How many actors are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM actor

question: How many film categories are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM category

question: How many films are rated R?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'R'

question: What is the longest film length in minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT max(length) FROM film

question: What is the average rental rate across all films?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(rental_rate) FROM film

question: How many rentals have not been returned yet?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL

question: How many customers live in Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer c JOIN address a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer c JOIN address a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many films are in the Comedy category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy'

question: What is the total revenue from all payments?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment

question: Which actor has appeared in the most films?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many films are there in each language?
gold_sql: SELECT l.name, count(*) FROM film f JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id GROUP BY l.name

question: How many films are there for each rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, count(*) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: Which staff member processed the most payments?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM payment p JOIN staff s ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many film copies does store 1 have in its inventory?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM inventory WHERE store_id = 1

question: How many customers have never made a payment?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id = c.customer_id)

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spending?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, sum(p.amount) FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which film category earns the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT category FROM sales_by_film_category ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which store had more rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT i.store_id FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY i.store_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the 3 most rented films?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many customers have made more than 40 rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 40) t

question: On average, how much has each paying customer spent in total?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(total) FROM (SELECT sum(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) t

question: Which city has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ci.city FROM customer c JOIN address a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id GROUP BY ci.city_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the total revenue for each month of 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2022-01-01' AND payment_date < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', payment_date) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', payment_date)

question: Which year had the highest total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT extract(year FROM payment_date) FROM payment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have rented an Action film but never a Comedy film?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category ca ON ca.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND ca.name = 'Action') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category ca ON ca.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND ca.name = 'Comedy')

question: What percentage of films are rated PG-13?
gold_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 'PG-13') / count(*), 2) FROM film

question: Who is our most loyal customer, measured by number of rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which film was rented the most at store 1?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE i.store_id = 1 GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which film category has the longest average film length?
gold_sql: SELECT ca.name FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category ca ON ca.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY ca.name ORDER BY avg(f.length) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 countries by total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT co.country FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id JOIN address a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many films have never been rented?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: How many customers have spent more than the average customer?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sum(amount) AS t FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) x WHERE t > (SELECT avg(t) FROM (SELECT sum(amount) AS t FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) y)

question: How many rentals were returned late, meaning after the film's allowed rental duration?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE r.return_date > r.rental_date + f.rental_duration * interval '1 day'

question: Which actor's films have generated the most rental revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
